//: Two hosting sites (pivotdevshop.com and the private menu board at menu.pivotdevshop.com) and Firestore rules. The Firestore database holds the digital menu (menuItems) — see CLAUDE.md. No Functions and no Auth; if either arrives, add it here rather than in a second repo, the way famous-people owns its rules.

rewrites.//: Serve /case-study from case-study.html so the shared URL has no extension. A single rewrite rather than `cleanUrls`, which would apply to the whole site. The page moved here from playfamouspeople.com, which now redirects /case-study to this URL — so this path is already out in the world and must not change.
The two solution write-ups, same single-rewrite shape as /case-study rather than cleanUrls for the whole site.

headers.//: Pre-launch: keep the placeholder out of search results. This header is what actually does the work — robots.txt only asks crawlers not to fetch, and a page that is never fetched can still be listed as a bare URL. Crawling stays allowed precisely so this is seen. DELETE THIS BLOCK AT LAUNCH.

The only script is /analytics.js (Google Analytics 4), kept in its own file so script-src needs no 'unsafe-inline' — just 'self' and Google's tag host. connect-src and img-src name the GA hosts Google documents for its tag: the hits go out as beacons or, as a fallback, image requests. style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' because the markup is built out of style= attributes and there is no build step to hash them. Both faces are served from public/fonts/, so font-src is 'self' and no Google Fonts host appears anywhere in this policy.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://www.googletagmanager.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.googletagmanager.com; connect-src 'self' https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.analytics.google.com https://*.googletagmanager.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'none'

headers.//: Fonts are the one thing here that can be cached hard. A face never changes without its filename changing, and a re-download of 76KB on every visit is the slowest thing on an otherwise static page.
An hour, not a year: the whole point of this repo is that a wording change is a merge, and a merge nobody sees for a day is not.

hosting.//: The menu board. Private: not linked from anywhere, and noindex on every response so it never appears in search. That hides it from search, not from someone who has the URL.

headers.//: The board. script-src needs 'unsafe-inline': the board is one self-contained file with its script inline, rebuilt by a bundler that would invalidate a hash on every edit. connect-src is the Firestore REST endpoint the prices come from, and fonts are embedded as data: URIs. No frame-ancestors, so a signage player can still embed it. Scoped to the board's own paths so it never overlaps the editor's policy below.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; font-src data:; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src https://firestore.googleapis.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; object-src 'none'

headers.//: The price editor. Script is external (admin.js) so no 'unsafe-inline'. gstatic serves the Firebase SDK and apis.google.com the loader firebase-auth pulls in; the auth iframe lives on the project's authDomain. connect-src 'self' is for /__/firebase/init.json and reading the board to know which SKUs are on it.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://www.gstatic.com https://apis.google.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.googleapis.com https://www.gstatic.com; frame-src https://pivot-dev-shop.firebaseapp.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'none'
